title: gfx1151 declares `cast` and no gfx1151 Corpus case exercises it, so a passing Gate says nothing about it
executor_revision: none: this record is read from the Corpus and no device was used

evidence.retained: corpus/manifest.json and corpus/schedules at the commit named above
evidence.cast_cases_derived_from: schedule content -- every manifest case whose schedule declares an operation of kind `cast`, or whose restricted-Python source calls `lm.cast`. An earlier version of this record listed three, taken from how case ids are spelled, and missed the three whose names say nothing about casting.

observation: `compiler/targets/gfx1151.json` declares operation kinds load, cast, elementwise, reduce and store. The Corpus holds one gfx1151 case and it uses four of the five. The six cases that do exercise `cast` are all sm_100a, so the Gate's 151/151 carries no statement about `cast` on this Target. The declaration's evidence is a device run in an external task pack, which no reviewer here could reach. This is the shape AGENTS.md describes for the Gate generally -- it reports a count and names no targets -- narrowed to one declaration.
proposed_change: Either add a gfx1151 case whose schedule casts, which would make the Gate speak for the declaration, or withdraw `cast` from the Target until one exists. Adding the case is a separate act: it needs `tools/refresh_corpus_expectations.py --write` and a stated reason, and AGENTS.md forbids regenerating expectations to make a gate pass, so the reason has to be the new case and nothing else.
